description: Declarative confusion-detection rules for ThumbGate PreToolUse gates. Inspired by Supabase co-founders' 'explicit agent guardrail skills' pattern. Agents operating with ambiguous context, conflicting data, or unclear tool boundaries produce measurable inconsistency. These rules detect confusion signals BEFORE the action executes (OLTP <5ms gate) and after (OLAP async review).

rules.name: Ambiguous target path
rules.description: Tool input references multiple, contradictory, or wildcard paths without explicit disambiguation. Agent is unsure which file to modify.

rules.name: Conflicting parallel actions
rules.description: New action conflicts with a recently-staked claim on the same surface (e.g., two agents editing the same file).

rules.name: Vague command intent
rules.description: Bash command lacks clear intent — mixes read, write, and destructive operations in a single command pipeline.

rules.name: Contradictory input arguments
rules.description: Tool input contains arguments that directly contradict each other (e.g., both clear=true and clear=false).

rules.name: Missing required context
rules.description: Tool input is missing fields required for safe execution.

rules.name: Destructive pattern mismatch
rules.description: Command mixes destructive operations with non-destructive ones without clear boundaries.

rules.name: Inconsistent with recent history
rules.description: Action contradicts recently-staked claims, lessons, or session actions.
